title: Handle form elements when resolving submission attributes
body: Handle the form-self submitter case in the action, method, enctype, no-validate and target lookups. submit(), requestSubmit() with no argument, and implicit submission without a submit button can use the form itself as submitter, but form has no form owner. For target lookup, use the form only when submitter is the form. For ordinary submit buttons, retain the existing lookup through the submitter's current form owner, including after submission-event mutations. This does not redefine the latter edge case. Suggested coverage: form.submit(), requestSubmit() without an argument, implicit submission, submission attributes, and reassociation of a submit button during submit/formdata.
